target_customer: African fintechs and businesses that need to issue virtual and physical Mastercard or Visa cards
problem: African fintechs depended on a few card issuers that could drop customers without notice, leaving them unable to offer cards.
business_model: API based card issuing, with fees per card and transaction

founders.name: Tunde Adewole
founders.background_notes: YC page bio says he scaled Bridgecard to over $1M ARR before exiting (his own claim, meaning of exit unclear) and now builds Ledgerline, an audit CPA firm.

founders.name: Festus Owumi
founders.background_notes: YC page: senior software engineer with about five years at African financial services companies.

competitors.name: Sudo Africa
competitors.what: Nigerian card issuing API platform for developers and businesses

competitors.name: Union54
competitors.what: Zambian card issuing API whose outage in mid 2022 disrupted fintechs including Barter by Flutterwave

technical_complexity.rationale: Card issuing relies on sponsor banks and processors, with PCI DSS compliance and fraud controls the hard parts for a five person team.

defensibility.rationale: Issuer partnerships and PCI DSS compliance (claimed) are a modest barrier, but Sudo Africa, Union54 and others sold the same API.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Mastercard pressure over chargebacks forced Nigerian virtual card issuers to suspend service in April and July 2022; no source shows Bridgecard being acquired.

market_need_then: In 2022 many Nigerian fintechs offered virtual dollar cards, and when issuers deactivated them over chargebacks the demand for alternative issuers was visible in coverage by Techcabal and the Condia.

branding.domain_note: Uses bridgecard.cards in the directory and bridgecard.app on the company about page.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found; the name resembles Bridge, Bridger and other payments names.

pivots.from: Consumer app and card that combines bank accounts, wallets and cards into one
pivots.to: Card issuing API for African fintechs
pivots.why: YC launch post says the founders' previous card issuer stopped supporting them and other companies, so they became the issuer; the pre-seed article of May 2022 still describes the consumer product.

outcome_analysis: The cause of Bridgecard's inactive status is not public. The company raised a $440K pre-seed in May 2022, entered YC in Summer 2022 as an issuing API, and a cofounder later says he scaled it past $1M ARR before leaving. The 2022 Mastercard chargeback crackdown hit the card issuing market, but no source ties it to the outcome.
notes: Pre-seed reported by The Condia (May 13, 2022) and Weetracker (May 17, 2022). Totals conflict: CB Insights says $2.44M over 5 rounds, Caplight $1.44M, so rounds are likely missing and their details were not found. Website fetch returned only a tagline, no shutdown notice; the about page fetch was rate limited. The Union54 source is dated about one month after the batch start. The Condia article names no competitors. Founder education not found.
